item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-10
item.description: China accelerates the OSSification of industrial infrastructure: the OpenAtom Foundation launches its Control Systems Open Source Community on the industrial-software conference stage; Anolis (OpenAnolis) donates itself to OpenAtom and rebrands as 'AI-native'; The Diplomat charts WAICO's institutional agenda in the West's absence; KAIYUANSHE publishes its 2026 board of directors.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-07
item.description: US-China schedule first official AI talks under Trump; Bessent warns of sanctions over AI IP 'theft'; China formalizes WAICO with 29 founding members; SPC overhauls chip-design IP with punitive damages; controversial open-source licensing rulings continue to shape China's legal landscape.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-31
item.description: State media consolidates open-weight AI success narrative; openEuler Hong Kong User Group launches with 22 members; West debates slowing AI as China builds parallel governance; the open-weight dilemma emerges.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-21
item.description: NDRC eight-point AI Action Plan, Trump admin considers ban on Chinese open-source models, Mulan copyleft license submitted to OSI, and Qiushi essay on AI ideology

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-20
item.description: WAICO founded, Kimi K3 released as largest open-source model, Xi calls for open collaboration at WAIC 2026, and openKylin advances AI-native OS
